description: Thresholds for the local conditional hypothesis Brain. Every value here is a development default chosen so the five lifecycle operations are reachable on a short replay; none has been fitted or validated against out-of-sample outcomes.

trajectory.identity: two channels. Direction carries where the path went and how far (r5/r15/r30/r60, incremental MFE/MAE, time-to-extreme, path efficiency). Shape carries the curve with the endpoint trend removed and rescaled to unit RMS, projected onto a globally fitted principal basis. Realized volatility is an attribute and never an identity dimension.
trajectory._identity_note: Fitting the raw cumulative-return curve put 80.7% of the variance on a single direction axis, so distance degenerated into a quantization of where the path ended and 'fell, came back, rallied' became indistinguishable from 'rallied straight'. Splitting the two channels and standardizing each on its own is what keeps path geometry in the representation.

proposer._minimum_mass_note: The share of the retrieved neighbourhood a cluster needs before it is surfaced as a representative future. Mass below this is left to the residual rather than named.
proposer._local_cut_note: How many pieces the retrieved neighbourhood is cut into is decided per clock, not fixed. Every k from 2 to max_cluster_count is scored by mean silhouette and the best wins only if it clears separation_floor; otherwise the cloud is one mode and k_t = 1. A constant k manufactures structure on quiet clocks and hides it on contested ones.
proposer._separation_floor_note: 0.15 is a development default, not a fitted one. It is the silhouette below which a multi-way cut is treated as decoration rather than structure. Measured over the ten sessions 2022-01-17..28 it never bound: k_t = 1 did not occur once, so the single-mode branch has unit-test coverage only. max_cluster_count did bind, on 62.1% of clocks, which means the clouds wanted a finer cut than the ceiling allowed and the adaptive rule behaved mostly as a k=6 chooser (separation 0.2330 against 0.2267 for fixed k=6).
proposer._max_nodes_note: How many representative futures the cloud surfaces, deliberately larger than pool.max_live_hypotheses. A SPLIT is made of a node the pool has no slot for yet; capping extraction at the number of slots makes it unreachable by construction.

pool._association_note: association_max_distance_scale is a fraction of the representation's own spread (ForecastIndex.component_scale), not an absolute distance: coordinates scale with the window's volatility, so a fixed number would mean something different in every regime. Distance is measured on the centroid and the cluster's spread together, because two clouds can share a centre and be nothing alike.
pool._support_note: identity_minimum_overlap, split_minimum_inheritance and merge_minimum_inheritance read the historical observation points supporting each node, not its coordinates. A geometric match whose support has been replaced is not an update; a split needs one claim's support genuinely divided between two separated nodes; a merge needs two supports to converge and the information gap between the claims to close. All four values are development defaults, none fitted. Measured over 2022-01-17..28: surviving hypotheses carried a median support overlap of 0.626, and 29.4% of survivals sat below 0.50 — that is the share a geometry-only rule would have mislabelled as clean updates. SPLIT fired 1,754 times against zero under the v2 geometry rule; MERGE fired 21 times, rare because it requires both convergence and a closed information gap.
